verdict.rationale: PayPal documents concrete paths for in-chat purchase completion — ACP for ChatGPT and UCP for Google AI Mode/Gemini via Braintree tokenized checkout, plus Store Sync for full-catalog conversational purchases — with real API endpoints (createcart/getcart) and reverse-API flows. However, coverage is narrower than the story implies: access is form-gated/not self-serve, Braintree is required (not plain PayPal), Store Sync is limited to US-only physical goods in USD, Google's UCP path requires separate Google merchant registration, and no Claude or Copilot integration is evidenced at all. missing for 10: Claude/Copilot support, self-serve enablement without gating, broader Store Sync scope (digital goods/international), independent/hands-on confirmation of live buyer checkouts.
